summary: A provenance-backed authority packet precisely identifies the irreducible residual allowed by Issue #3. No production nFET is promoted: the existing V2.2/MAX17527A branch contract is numerically inconsistent before nFET qualification begins. No CAD, footprint, rule, connectivity, queue, or product-envelope change was made.
proposed_decision: Keep P24-EXACT-NFET-ENERGY-AUTHORITY and downstream CAD work parked. Product/Power Authority must first issue a corrected per-loop current and complete-path drop contract preserving the 300 W sustained, 330 W peak, six-loop/no-sharing requirements. Only then qualify an exact nFET, fuse/TVS coordination, harness, thermal installation, and FLAG/reset behavior.
evidence: MAX17527A maximum RON plus provisional fuse cold resistance is 61.58 mOhm, exceeding the entire 60.345 mOhm sustained path allowance before external nFET, connector, harness, PCB, or common-bus resistance.
With STL125N10LF8AG and the retained V2.2 allocations, sustained drop is at least 0.710804 V, yielding only 10.689196 V from an 11.4 V source versus the required 11.05 V.
The 6.25 kOhm SETI contract guarantees 5.754245754 A minimum per loop, 45.754246 mA below the 5.8 A target. Aggregate margin cannot qualify independent no-sharing branches.
STL125N10LF8AG already drops 33.64 mV at its guaranteed 4.5 V, 25 C point versus a 30 mV allocation; no guaranteed 4.45 V hot RDS(on) exists.
MAX17527A contributes up to 1.91748 W per loop at 5.8 A, or 11.50488 W across six loops, before hot-resistance correction.

MAX17527A fast-trip response is only 3 us typical; SMBJ18A clamp data is specified at 20.6 A rather than the 32 A trip ceiling; fuse evidence conflicts between 270 A2s melting and 308 A2s pre-arcing definitions. No worst-case waveform coordination is possible.

The bounded manufacturer-source search found no suitable modern low-milliohm, at least 100 V nFET with guaranteed maximum RDS(on) at VGS no greater than 4.45 V. IRL540PbF meets the gate discriminator but would drop 0.638 V and dissipate 3.70 W at 5.8 A.
Power Integrity Authority returned AUTHORITY_LEVEL_FAILURE_WITH_PRECISE_RESIDUAL; Librarian, Supervisor, electrical, thermal, and independent verifier findings concurred.
